correctness.rationale: For a uniform random endofunction [n]→[n], rooted-forest counting gives P(C_n=m)=m(n)_m/n^{m+1}. Conditional on m cyclic vertices, their permutation is uniform, so F_n has rencontres Q_m. Unconditionally the n fixed-point indicators are independent Bernoulli(1/n), hence F_n~Bin(n,1/n), E(F_n|C_n)=1 and Cov(F_n,C_n)=0; m=1 shows dependence and I>0 for all n≥2. Exact entropy identity I=Σ_m w_{n,m}D(Q_m||Pois(1))−D(Bin(n,1/n)||Pois(1)) is a KL chain rule. Alternating-series derangement remainder gives D(Q_m||Pois1)≤(e2^{m+1}+1)/(m+1)!, allowing dominated convergence n w→m. A likelihood expansion with factorial-moment tail bounds makes Bin-Pois KL O(n⁻²). Therefore n I→Σ_{m≥1}mD(Q_m||Pois1)=3.692926238979770132438700...; independent high-precision 35-term summation and rigorous 30-tail bound <1.5×10⁻24 reproduced the number. Finite enumeration of maps through 6 in source script is not an infinite argument.
